## F47 research record

### Rebar artifact

Path: src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt

Retrieval date: 2026-08-24

Revision inspected: 8cbf31007a350edfe74a79faf8e60ee728598a5e

SHA-256: 465e54dca65e1fbbb061d77244e6f0d1239d936df1130c0401421b47a0479628

Git blob: 188808db8c12356ff4dd45d4a7723d5688245ba7

Size: 12,803 bytes

Line count: 2,341 lines. The file contains 1,196 adjective lines, one separator, and 1,144 noun lines.

Introduction commit: b534f47a7f9bf216498bac941a28e9b91c3c3189, dated 2026-06-08. The commit title is Extract DSO ticket system + Jira reconciler into standalone rebar.

Comparison method: git log --follow, SHA-256, line and byte counts, and Git blob identity.

Result: Rebar history contains no later change to this file. The introduction commit says that the DSO wordlist shipped verbatim.

Canonical location: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/b534f47a7f9bf216498bac941a28e9b91c3c3189/src/rebar/_engine/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt

### Digital Service Orchestra source

Canonical location: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/blob/8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956/plugins/dso/resources/ticket-wordlist.txt

Retrieval date: 2026-08-24

Source revision: 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956. This revision introduced the final byte set on 2026-05-12.

Comparison method: SHA-256 and Git blob comparison between the DSO source revision, the Rebar extraction revision, both repository tips, and the working files.

Result: All four copies have SHA-256 465e54dca65e1fbbb061d77244e6f0d1239d936df1130c0401421b47a0479628 and Git blob 188808db8c12356ff4dd45d4a7723d5688245ba7. Immediate provenance from this DSO path is proven.

History inspected:

- 2d1b6b7eff67625cca967ebb9e4f4b13b5109784 introduced the file on 2026-04-29. Its SHA-256 was eb7763ffcf164fbc236e602d245558a9af8543fc36b385d79afa0801ed7426c2.
- 1b3b75d311943e3822b17f72cb3abacc9ab64e3c expanded it on 2026-04-30. Its SHA-256 was e560b427dde779ae33676928d6c0669324447af7c7441bb710d9d19edc2fbc00.
- 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956 produced the bytes later extracted into Rebar.

Historical ticket sources inspected:

- https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/blob/tickets/2017-0b9a/1777499909794480000-111f1ff0-ac5f-412e-835b-1da22e107186-SNAPSHOT.json
- https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/blob/tickets/3e74-56da/1777539546835578000-e140baa8-1229-4228-a780-30cb5c4e7f0e-SNAPSHOT.json

The task required common English words and named no source. The epic described the file as an in-repository curated list. It recorded that coolname was considered and rejected in favor of an in-repository list. Neither source records a corpus, retrieval location, generation method, attribution, or file-specific license.

### License record

Canonical location: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/blob/8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956/LICENSE

Retrieval date: 2026-08-24

Source revisions: 57ea82100e4f3e3953a3a663fad4c864bb56d8e7 introduced Apache License 2.0 to the DSO project on 2026-05-05. Revision 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956 contains that license and the final wordlist bytes.

Primary record: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/53

Comparison method: commit history, file presence at the final wordlist revision, and license-byte comparison with Rebar commit a001e4071ae8608210c154692fbc2b549c859dbf.

Result: The DSO license and the Rebar license added by a001e4071ae8608210c154692fbc2b549c859dbf share SHA-256 c71d239df91726fc519c6eb72d318ec65820627232b2f796219e87dcf35d0ab4. The Rebar commit states that the license was copied verbatim from DSO. This proves the DSO project license present at the final source revision. It does not establish whether an antecedent corpus exists or what terms would govern such a corpus.

### Candidate comparison

Coolname location: https://github.com/alexanderlukanin13/coolname/tree/7f895eed330e39830d7042ee03395a332495480c

Coolname retrieval date: 2026-08-24

Coolname revision: 7f895eed330e39830d7042ee03395a332495480c

Coolname comparison method: repository tree inspection, list-format inspection, SHA-256 comparison, and code search for distinctive legacy entries caulky, outsy, and sumpy.

Coolname result: Its data is split into categorized generator lists with headers and a different vocabulary shape. The inspected adjective file has SHA-256 cad9e3de75ce98892abbb422c81d311ff4369131fff4daa1cc49ffa1332d722c. The three distinctive entries were absent. Coolname is disproven as the exact byte source. Individual-word borrowing remains unproven.

Adjective-adjective-animal location: https://github.com/a-type/adjective-adjective-animal/tree/877ec25a2d0b54044f8a60b50cc2456a80345910

Adjective-adjective-animal retrieval date: 2026-08-24

Adjective-adjective-animal revision: 877ec25a2d0b54044f8a60b50cc2456a80345910

Adjective-adjective-animal comparison method: source-list format inspection, SHA-256 comparison, and code search for caulky, outsy, and sumpy.

Adjective-adjective-animal result: Its JavaScript arrays contain capitalized adjectives and animal names rather than the legacy adjective and noun layout. The adjective and animal files have SHA-256 values 676c44d9203d2e81b04724e87224ab3034f0d6d63cc83b295de0e33e9d834ef1 and 0ef18e4f38f63eeb716639849104c75128165ccaaab121286142e2081a46c872. The three distinctive entries were absent. This repository is disproven as the exact legacy byte source. It is the documented source for the separate v2 wordlist and does not establish legacy provenance.

### Discovery coverage

GitHub public code search was run for the exact filename and for distinctive combinations from the legacy file. Results for the filename were limited to DSO and Rebar. No external match was returned for caulky, outsy, and sumpy. Negative search results do not prove originality.

### Conclusion

Immediate provenance: proven. The Rebar file is byte-identical to the DSO file at revision 8c5621390668d97e7314c39e06eaab780b504956.

Antecedent provenance: unresolved. No primary source names a prior corpus or records how the words were selected.

Source repository license: proven. The DSO repository carried Apache License 2.0 at the final source revision, and Rebar later copied the same license bytes.

Complete upstream license chain: unresolved. The repository license does not identify or rule out an antecedent corpus.

Repository correction: none is supported by the available evidence. Adding an attribution or corpus-specific license would overstate the record. The legacy file should remain byte-identical. No follow-up proposal was created.
